name: bkit
description: Classical machine learning for Bantu: scikit-learn's shape, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting implementation inside it rather than beside it. Phases K1-K4 of twelve: the estimator protocol, Pipeline with step__param addressing, eleven preprocessing transformers, model selection (train_test_split, four splitters, cross_val_score, GridSearchCV/RandomizedSearchCV), and metrics -- classification from one confusion matrix, tie-handled ROC and PR curves, clipped log_loss, the regression set, NDCG and MRR. metrics.b depends on nothing but numba. Reproducibility comes from nd_seed alone; splitters return index arrays and never copy data.
